reliability_note: The first-party help page states 6 GB of free storage and 10 TB under Premium. The FAQ states a monthly basic transfer quota of 40 TB cloud download, 4 TB downstream and 1 TB upload; in excess usage, download speed to the device is limited to 100 KB/s after 7 days and files over quota are deleted after a 6-month window. Non-Premium accounts with 12 months of no login may be deleted.
